about: Refactor 17, Stage B, decision D1: the files of the surface email join one workspace package @purin-labs/surface-email in surfaces/email. scripts/refactor-17/move-module.mjs reads this plan. files: each source file that scripts/layers.json gives the module, with its place in the target folder: a Worker file goes to server/ with its sub-path below services/platform/src/. No folder of the module has the name email/, so each file keeps its first folder (mail/ stays mail/), and no two files share a place. sourcePrefixes: where --sync-plan puts a file that the module gets later. package: the manifest and the tsconfig of the new package; the versions of devDependencies come from the Worker manifest. The exports map gives each .ts file of server/ as an entry. The tsconfig of the package reads server/ only. The Worker tsconfigs include surfaces/*/server, so each file stays in the program that checked it before the move. edits: text edits of the files that name a source folder and cannot read scripts/lib/source-roots.mjs; an edit is done when the file holds its replace text. keepForm: each file where an import stays on its line, because the wrap of Prettier would move a ratchet, with its reason. regenerate: the commands that write a generated file again. package.typeCheck false: the package has no check:types script of its own. Its own files read the Env keys CONNECTOR, which services/platform/src/actors/connector.ts (workers/platform) merges, ORGANISATION, which services/platform/src/actors/organisation.ts (workers/platform) merges, and EVENT_Q, which services/platform/src/ingress-queue.ts of the surface webhooks merges, each with declare module of @purin-labs/kernel/env. Through the foundation packages that it imports the program also lacks CASE, CODE_MODE_SANDBOX, MESSAGE_LINK_FETCH and SESSION. The package alone gives 238 errors, 11 of them in its own files. The Worker program checks each file of server/.

edits.why: the lints of the Worker source and ESLint read the Worker files of the package
